NORTHBRIDGE INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
Office of the Controller of Examinations
Ref: NIT/COE/2026/147
Date: 22 September 2026
NOTICE - Odd Semester Examination Schedule
All students of 3rd, 5th and 7th semester B.E. are informed that the odd
semester examinations will commence on 10 November 2026. Hall tickets will be
available on the student portal from 3 November 2026.
Examination fee: Rs. 4,800 (regular) Last date for payment: 5 October 2026
Payment mode: UPI to 9876543210@okaxis immediately to avoid late fee of Rs. 500
Students with attendance below 75% must contact their Head of Department
before 15 October 2026.
Sd/-
Controller of Examinations
VISUAL_NOTES: none
extracted.sender: Office of the Controller of Examinations

signals.title: Suspicious payment method
signals.explanation: The notice requests examination fees to be paid via a personal or generic UPI ID rather than an official institutional bank account or portal.
signals.uncertainty: The institution might have temporarily adopted UPI payments for convenience, though using a standard mobile number UPI is highly unusual for official university transactions.

signals.title: Immediate action pressure
signals.explanation: The document uses urgent language to pressure students into making immediate payments to avoid penalties.
signals.evidence: immediately to avoid late fee of Rs. 500
signals.uncertainty: Academic institutions do enforce strict deadlines and late fees, which can naturally create a sense of urgency.

signals.title: Implausible payment channel
signals.explanation: An official Controller of Examinations notice typically directs students to an official ERP portal or bank challan rather than a direct UPI address.
signals.uncertainty: The college might have partnered with a third-party payment gateway that utilizes this specific UPI handle, though it remains unverified.

inconsistencies: The notice instructs students to pay via UPI to a mobile-linked virtual payment address, but states that hall tickets will be available on the 'student portal', where payment features are normally integrated.
signal_set.recommendation: Do not send any money to the UPI address listed in the notice.
what_to_verify: Check the official Northbridge Institute of Technology student portal directly for any active fee payment links.
Contact the Office of the Controller of Examinations or your Head of Department using trusted, established phone numbers to verify the notice.
Verify if the UPI ID '9876543210@okaxis' belongs to an official bank account registered under the institution's legal name.
